query: SELECT e.id AS experiment_id,m.reservation_id FROM eval_request_reservations m JOIN eval_executions x ON x.id=m.execution_id JOIN eval_experiments e ON e.id=x.experiment_id JOIN eval_resource_revisions c ON c.id=x.case_revision_id AND c.owner_id=e.owner_id WHERE e.owner_id=$1 AND x.id=$2 AND m.request_id=$3 AND m.traffic_class='suggestion' AND c.content->'content'->>'partition'='development'
